one_line: Opposed commanders on the Sindh frontier during the Umayyad campaigns of 711–712 CE.

appearance.age_look: Raja Dahir appears as a dignified man in his late 40s with a sturdy, regal build; Muhammad ibn Qasim appears as a focused young commander in his early 20s with a lean, athletic frame.
appearance.face: Raja Dahir has an oval face, medium-brown Sindhi complexion, straight nose, neatly groomed black-and-grey moustache and short beard, strong brows and a calm yet resolute default expression; Muhammad ibn Qasim has a slightly angular face, warm light-brown complexion, sharp dark eyes, straight nose, trimmed moustache and short beard shadow, with a composed, determined default expression.
appearance.hair: Raja Dahir’s hair is long, straight, black with a few grey strands, tied in a low knot at the back and partly hidden under a simple golden cloth turban with a narrow red band; Muhammad ibn Qasim has straight, dark-brown hair cut just above the shoulders with a center part, mostly covered by a rounded dark leather war-cap wrapped with a plain off-white cloth band as a light turban.
appearance.costume: Raja Dahir wears a long, ankle-length cotton tunic (angarkha-style) in deep saffron yellow with side-tied overlap and narrow brown edging, over loose off-white trousers and a broad maroon cotton sash at the waist; over this he has a sleeveless, quilted cotton vest in muted olive green with subtle vertical stitching, and a light cream shawl draped over one shoulder; his feet are in simple brown leather sandals, and he wears modest gold stud earrings, a thin gold necklace, and a single broad gold bangle on each wrist; Muhammad ibn Qasim wears a knee-length, long-sleeved tunic of undyed beige cotton, belted with a wide dark-red leather girdle, over narrow dark-brown trousers and soft dark-brown leather boots reaching mid-calf; over the tunic he has a sleeveless lamellar-style cuirass suggested by overlapping brown leather plates laced together, and a rectangular dark-green wool cloak, plain and unpatterned, clasped at one shoulder, which can hang back to reveal the armour; he has a simple leather wrist-guard on his right arm and a plain iron ring on one hand.
appearance.signature: Raja Dahir carries a slightly curved, single-edged steel sword with a simple straight cross-guard, plain brass hilt and a dark wooden scabbard hanging from his maroon sash, while Muhammad ibn Qasim carries a straight double-edged steel sword with a simple cross-guard, plain leather-wrapped hilt and a brown scabbard suspended from his dark-red leather belt.

ref_desc: Raja Dahir is a sturdy late-40s Sindhi king with medium-brown skin, long black hair tied under a golden turban, saffron angarkha, olive quilted vest and maroon sash carrying a curved sword, beside young Muhammad ibn Qasim in beige tunic, brown lamellar armour, dark-green cloak and straight sword.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet featuring two fixed characters from the 8th-century Sindh frontier: first, Raja Dahir as a dignified, sturdy man in his late 40s with medium-brown skin, oval face, strong brows, neat black-and-grey moustache and short beard, long straight black hair tied in a low knot under a simple golden cloth turban with a narrow red band; he wears a long ankle-length saffron-yellow angarkha-style cotton tunic with a side-tied overlap and narrow brown edging, over loose off-white trousers, a broad maroon cotton sash at the waist, a sleeveless quilted olive-green cotton vest with visible vertical stitching, and a light cream shawl draped over one shoulder, plus brown leather sandals, modest gold stud earrings, a thin gold necklace and one broad gold bangle on each wrist, and he carries a slightly curved single-edged steel sword with straight cross-guard, plain brass hilt and dark wooden scabbard hanging from his sash; second, Muhammad ibn Qasim as a lean young commander in his early 20s with warm light-brown complexion, slightly angular face, sharp dark eyes, trimmed moustache and short beard shadow, straight dark-brown hair just above the shoulders mostly covered by a rounded dark leather war-cap wrapped with an off-white cloth band, wearing a knee-length long-sleeved beige cotton tunic belted with a wide dark-red leather girdle, narrow dark-brown trousers, mid-calf dark-brown leather boots, a sleeveless brown leather lamellar-style cuirass of overlapping plates laced together over the tunic, and a plain dark-green wool cloak clasped at one shoulder, plus a leather wrist-guard on his right arm and a plain iron ring; he carries a straight double-edged steel sword with simple cross-guard, leather-wrapped hilt and brown scabbard on his belt; show both characters front and three-quarter views in the same image, clearly presenting their faces, fixed hairstyles, full outfits head-to-toe, signature swords and the dominant palette of saffron yellow, maroon, olive green, beige and dark brown in a clean, heroic, historically grounded shonen-anime style.
